# .github AGENTS.md

## Purpose

GitHub repository configuration, prompts, workflows, and issue/PR automation metadata.

## Read Order

1. Open the exact workflow, prompt, or configuration file tied to the task.
2. Cross-check `.agents/skills/` or root `AGENTS.md` only when changing agent-facing workflow behavior.

## Avoid

- Do not inspect all workflows or prompts for an unrelated application change.
- Do not duplicate persistent repo rules here when root `AGENTS.md` owns them.
